description: WRITE tool — bulk-untrack keywords for an app in the caller's Sonar workspace. Pass `all: true` to remove every tracked keyword, OR `ids: [...]` to remove specific ones (exactly one of the two). Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

all.description: Set true to untrack ALL keywords for the app. Mutually exclusive with `ids` — pass exactly one of `all` or `ids`.

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_list_apps or sonar_create_product. NOT a store id.

ids.description: Tracked-keyword ids to untrack (from sonar_app_keywords). Mutually exclusive with `all` — pass exactly one of `all` or `ids`.

name: sonar_untrack_keywords
title: Untrack Keywords
